name: Audacy
desc: US audio company owning more than 220 radio stations across 47 media markets, plus podcasts and the Audacy streaming app.
products: radio stations, podcasts, Audacy app, Audacy Sports
parent_ultimate: Soros Fund Management (controlling interest after Chapter 11)

fin.note: older than three years; only figure on the page

qualifying_metric: revenue (FY2018, old) plus scale: 220+ stations, 47 markets

alt_indicators.evidence: over 220 radio stations across 47 US media markets
official audio and podcast partner of Major League Baseball; Audacy Sports serves about 150 pro and college teams

profitability_basis: net loss USD 361m in 2018; no recent figures
distress: Chapter 11 in 2024; emerged 30 Sep 2024 with about USD 1.6bn of debt converted to equity

signals.what: emerged from Chapter 11 as a private company controlled by Soros Fund Management

fit_rationale: Sports-heavy US radio network could use F1 as content and promotion, but its market is US-only and it is restructured; a media-rights or barter deal is likelier than cash sponsorship.
customer_overlap: BetMGM is exclusive sportsbook of its BetQL Network (MGM Resorts is an F1 partner)
category_conflict: potential: media partners such as CNBC, Paramount+, Financial Times

access.roles: Chief Marketing Officer; Head of Sports; Chief Revenue Officer

outstanding: current revenue and employees; post-bankruptcy budget

name: Automobili Lamborghini
desc: Italian maker of super sports cars and SUVs, owned by Audi, selling through 135 dealerships worldwide and running Squadra Corse racing.
products: Revuelto, Huracan/Temerario, Urus; GT3 and Super Trofeo race cars
customers: high-net-worth car buyers; private race teams
marketing_autonomy_basis: brand runs its own motorsport division but sits inside Audi, which owns an F1 team
markets: worldwide sales; Super Trofeo series in America, Asia and Europe
fit_rationale: Global luxury car brand with its own racing arm, but parent Audi owns an F1 team and rival carmakers dominate the grid, so a deal with another team is effectively blocked.
category_conflict: established: parent Audi (Volkswagen Group) owns the Audi F1 team; carmakers Ferrari, Mercedes-Benz, Aston Martin also on the grid
f1_markets: Italy, United States, Middle East, Japan, China and other GP countries

access.roles: Chief Marketing and Sales Officer; Head of Motorsport

outstanding: current employee count (page figure is 2020); whether Audi group policy forbids other F1 deals

name: Bet9ja
desc: Nigerian sports betting operator launched in 2013, run by KC Gaming Networks and licensed by the Lagos State Lotteries Board.
fit_rationale: Big Nigerian betting brand with a sponsorship habit, but its market is Nigeria only, with no Grand Prix; betting is crowded in F1 and regulators restrict it in many race markets.
category_conflict: potential: betting and gaming partners such as Betway, FanDuel, BK8, Jackpot City
compliance: betting advertising rules vary by Grand Prix market
outstanding: revenue, customers, ownership detail; route rests on sponsorships only
